fusions.name: Heaving Swell
fusions.desc: Heaves a wave of force outward, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Fires a heavy shot that deals 30 damage and bursts for 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Full Sail
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sea Legs
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%, and you resist water damage by 10%.
